description: Skelet AF-05d starter clean-consumer: generated starter installs typechecks builds starts

compatibility.instructions: Does extending STARTER_FILES from 4 to 9 plus pinned devDeps and layout import change break qualified starter/manifest/package interfaces? Is the kit manifest starter prefix open-ended (any starter/* path) so no frozen contract version bump is needed, and do existing callers keep working?

correctness.instructions: Are the 5 new starter files factually correct: tsconfig strict with bundler resolution and next plugin, next.config.mjs strict mode, tailwind.config.js with app content globs, postcss with tailwind+autoprefixer, globals.css directives, layout imports both globals.css and kit sibling, package.json typecheck script plus 4 new pinned devDeps? Does the clean-consumer proof (npm install 108 pkgs, tsc exit 0, next build static, next start 200 with placeholders) support the claim?

evidence.instructions: Is the new clean-build configs test plus real /tmp clean-consumer run (install/typecheck/build/start with honest warnings) sufficient? Are pinned versions recorded and is the Next 14.2.5 vuln warning plus Tailwind content warning preserved as negative evidence rather than hidden?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism in synthesis (byte-identical rebuilds preserved), pinned versions, or kit-sibling import that breaks reproducibility or fails open when siblings are absent?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond starter clean-consumer: new capture, traversal, billing, embeddings, paid services, donor imports, or unrelated refactors? Is the change limited to starter synthesis plus 2 test files?

security.instructions: Do new configs introduce secrets, remote code, or observed-copy leakage? Are all files Skelet synthesis with headers and placeholders, and does the kit-sibling import stay a static CSS reference (no executable trust)?
